title: Anthropic says internal Claude model found VP≠VNP, publishes Lean 4 proof
summary: Anthropic published a paper titled "VP ≠ VNP over every field" together with a Lean 4 formalization on November 24; the repository states the result was discovered by an internal research Claude model and that both the paper and code were written by AI. The paper claims a superpolynomial arithmetic-circuit lower bound for the Hamiltonian cycle polynomial, from which it derives that VP is a proper subclass of VNP — a result that, if correct, would resolve Valiant&\#x27;s 1979 algebraic complexity conjecture, though it addresses arithmetic circuits only and says nothing about P versus NP. The proof passed an audit against three standard axioms and an independent check by the nanoda kernel, with no \`sorry\` outside reserved files. No human mathematician has yet read it through, Lean cannot confirm that the formal statement matches the claimed theorem, and Appendix Q lists discrepancies; independent review is pending.
